''See also: [[Solstice Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Solstice is a powerful and elusive organization that exerts control over the [[Galactic Union]]. While some believe it to be a secret society responsible for orchestrating widespread chaos and manipulating political landscapes to facilitate peacekeeping interventions, others claim it is actually a collection of [[World Spirits]]. The entity possesses an information network that exceeds the [[scale]] of major corporations and is described as a formless specter that is difficult to combat. Despite its perceived omnipotence, it is composed of people rather than an undead hive-mind and maintains mortal concerns. The group has been accused of engineering conflicts, such as the [[destruction]] of its own vessels, to force confrontations and seize freedom from citizens across numerous worlds.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|During his era of conquest, [[Starhammer]] engaged in combat against the group known as Solstice. The organization maintains an information network that is significantly larger than any existing corporation and secretly puppeteers the [[Galactic Union]]. In a display of tactical aggression, Solstice once destroyed its own vessels to compel an engagement. Currently, the entity remains a primary target that [[Omega]] seeks to defeat.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Solstice]] has an information network that dwarfs any corporations.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c33">''The Engineer'', chapter 33</ref>}}</li>

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Solstice is a formless, specter-like enemy known for stealing freedom from average citizens across hundreds of planets. This entity is identified as a target by [[Omega]] and may have been attempting to ensnare the speaker within a web. While information gathered on a ship might be transmitted back to Solstice, the name also serves as a location where Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri is being welcomed.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Solstice is a mysterious Shadow{{!}}shadow organization rooted in the [[Galactic Union]] that operates through members positioned everywhere, including a high command of [[World Spirits]] who have turned against their mortal population. This entity is capable of hiring entire crews for off-the-books projects, ordering [[Union]] fleets without repercussions, and utilizing [[proton bombs]] or human shields to achieve its goals. Throughout various conflicts, the group has maintained unbreakable contracts with figures like Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax and acted as a former employer to [[Omega]], who holds a bleak hatred for them. After being tracked to the [[Zykaros system]], it was revealed that Solstice aims to take over the galaxy and has betrayed Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri. Ultimately, this group rules from the shadows, setting traps and controlling vital locations to maintain its influence.}}
